arxiv-2012-07854.title: Circularization of tidal debris around white dwarfs: implications for gas production and dust variability 2020 Circularization of tidal debris around white dwarfs: implications for gas production and dust variability – D
arxiv-2012-07854.creator: Uri Malamud, Evgeni Grishin, Marc Brouwers
arxiv-2012-07854.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Uri Malamud, Evgeni Grishin, Marc Brouwers. White dwarf (WD) pollution is thought to arise from the tidal disruption of planetary bodies. The initial fragment stream is extremely eccentric, while observational evidence suggest that discs are circular or nearly so. Here we propose a novel mechanism to bridge this gap and show that the fragments can rapidly circularise through dust or gas drag when they interact with a pre-existing compact disc.

arxiv-2205-05973.title: Geodesics in Generalised Ellis-Bronnikov Spacetime Embedded in Warped 5D Background
arxiv-2205-05973.creator: Vivek Sharma, Suman Ghosh
arxiv-2205-05973.description: Abstract We study the particle trajectories in the recently proposed five dimensional warped (generalized) Ellis-Bronnikov spacetime (5D-WGEB) (which does not require exotic matter) as well as it’s four dimensional counterpart (4D-GEB) in detail and conduct a comparative study. Analytical approach provides conditions which determines three types of trajectories (trapped, returning and crossing) for both 4D and 5D spacetimes.

arxiv-2208-11739.title: Rethinking Cost-sensitive Classification in Deep Learning via Adversarial Data Augmentation
arxiv-2208-11739.creator: Qiyuan Chen, Raed Al Kontar, Maher Nouiehed, Jessie Yang, Corey Lester
arxiv-2208-11739.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Qiyuan Chen, Raed Al Kontar, Maher Nouiehed, Jessie Yang, Corey Lester. Cost-sensitive classification is critical in applications where misclassification errors widely vary in cost. However, over-parameterization poses fundamental challenges to the cost-sensitive modeling of deep neural networks (DNNs). The ability of a DNN to fully interpolate a training dataset can render a DNN, evaluated purely on the training set, ineffective in distinguishing a cost-sensitive solution from its overall accuracy maximization counterpart. This necessitates rethinking cost-sensitive classification in DNNs.

arxiv-2305-08144.title: Mobile-Env: Building Qualified Evaluation Benchmarks for LLM-GUI Interaction
arxiv-2305-08144.creator: Danyang Zhang, Zhennan Shen, Rui Xie, Situo Zhang, Tianbao Xie, Zihan Zhao, Siyuan Chen, Lu Chen, Hongshen Xu, Ruisheng Cao, Kai Yu
arxiv-2305-08144.description: Abstract The Graphical User Interface (GUI) is pivotal for human interaction with the digital world, enabling efficient device control and the completion of complex tasks. Recent progress in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Language Models (VLMs) offers the chance to create advanced GUI agents.

arxiv-2308-04174.title: The parametrix construction of the heat kernel on a graph
arxiv-2308-04174.creator: Gautam Chinta, Jay Jorgenson, Anders Karlsson, Lejla Smajlović
arxiv-2308-04174.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Gautam Chinta, Jay Jorgenson, Anders Karlsson, Lejla Smajlović. In this paper we develop the parametrix approach for constructing the heat kernel on a graph G G . In particular, we highlight two specific cases. First, we consider the case when G G is embedded in a Eulidean domain or manifold Ω \Omega , and we use a heat kernel associated to Ω \Omega to obtain a formula for the heat kernel on G G .

arxiv-2502-03687.title: Conditional Diffusion Models are Medical Image Classifiers that Provide Explainability and Uncertainty for Free
arxiv-2502-03687.creator: Gian Mario Favero *, Parham Saremi *, Emily Kaczmarek, Brennan Nichyporuk, Tal Arbel
arxiv-2502-03687.description: Abstract Discriminative classifiers have become a foundational tool in deep learning for medical imaging, excelling at learning separable features of complex data distributions. However, these models often need careful design, augmentation, and training techniques to ensure safe and reliable deployment. Recently, diffusion models have become synonymous with generative modeling in 2D.

arxiv-2502-18225.title: Liver Cirrhosis Stage Estimation from MRI with Deep Learning
arxiv-2502-18225.creator: Jun Zeng, Debesh Jha, Ertugrul Aktas, Elif Keles, Alpay Medetalibeyoglu, Matthew Antalek, Federica Proietto Salanitri, Amir A. Borhani, Daniela P. Ladner, Gorkem Durak, Ulas Bagci
arxiv-2502-18225.description: Abstract We present an end-to-end deep learning framework for automated liver cirrhosis stage estimation from multi-sequence MRI. Cirrhosis is the severe scarring (fibrosis) of the liver and a common endpoint of various chronic liver diseases. Early diagnosis is vital to prevent complications such as decompensation and cancer, which significantly decreases life expectancy.

britannica-1911-cyprinodonts.title: Cyprinodonts (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-cyprinodonts.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-cyprinodonts.description: Article 'Cyprinodonts' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 7), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. called Cyprinodonts are in no way related to the Cyprinids, or carp family, but are near allies of the pike, characterized by a flat head with protractile mouth beset with cardiform, villiform, or compressed, bi- or tri-cuspid teeth, generally large scales, and the absence of a well-developed lateral line.

pmc-11428448.title: The mediating role of goal orientation in the relationship between formative assessment with academic engagement and procrastination in medical students
pmc-11428448.creator: Majid Yousefi Afrashteh, Parisa Janjani
pmc-11428448.description: BackgroundAcademic involvement and academic procrastination are two behavioral variables and are among the challenges of higher education, especially medical education. The purpose of the current research is to investigate the mediating role of goal orientation in the relationship between formative assessment with academic engagement and procrastination in Iranian medical students.

pmc-13182001.title: Multivalent Disabled Infectious Single Animal (DISA)-DIVA vaccine for all nine serotypes of African horse sickness virus (AHSV) is broadly protective in IFNAR (-/-) mice
pmc-13182001.creator: Sergio Utrilla-Trigo, Luis Jiménez-Cabello, René G. P. van Gennip, Piet A. van Rijn, Javier Ortego, Eva Calvo-Pinilla
pmc-13182001.description: African horse sickness (AHS) is a highly severe, midge-borne disease of equids showing a mortality rate of > 90% in naive domestic horses. Outbreaks are caused by AHS virus (AHSV) and result in devastating economic losses in developing countries as equids play a crucial role in the agricultural industry and many households.

pmc-13466523.title: Machine learning based model for the detection of multiple sclerosis from OCT-derived macular and optic disc retinal biomarkers
pmc-13466523.creator: Muhmmad Aqib Anwar, Ghassan Mohamedsalih, Fatema Al Mannaei, Anant Pai, Tanvir Alam
pmc-13466523.description: BackgroundMultiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic neurological disease characterized by inflammatory demyelination and progressive neuroaxonal damage. Retinal layer thickness in the macular and optic disc regions, measurable using optical coherence tomography (OCT), might be considered as a promising non-invasive biomarker for detecting MS-related neurodegeneration.

pmc-13547257.title: Lifecycle answerability for artificial intelligence-enabled medical device software: a regulatory science perspective
pmc-13547257.creator: Liu Ben
pmc-13547257.description: Artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled medical device software is increasingly expected to learn, update, explain, retrieve information, draft records, and support clinical reasoning across changing care environments. Regulatory science has responded with lifecycle-oriented tools, including software-as-a-medical-device risk categorization, quality management systems, medical device software lifecycle processes, risk management, post-market monitoring, and predetermined change control plans.

pmc-13669366.title: Privacy-preserving pangenome graphs
pmc-13669366.creator: Jacob Blindenbach, Shaunak Soni, Gamze Gürsoy
pmc-13669366.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The human pangenome reference, often represented as a graph, promises to capture genetic diversity across populations, but open release of individual haplotypes raises significant privacy concerns, including risks of re-identification and inference of sensitive traits. To address these challenges, we introduce PanMixer, a framework for privacy-preserving pangenome graph releases that selectively obfuscates an individual’s haplotypes while retaining the utility of the reference graph.

pmc-13688118.title: Novel use of an endoscopic suturing device for rectal foreign body retrieval
pmc-13688118.creator: Sergey V. Kantsevoy
pmc-13688118.description: Background and AimsEndoscopic removal of gastrointestinal tract foreign bodies could be difficult when the foreign body significantly exceeds the size of the available endoscopic extraction devices (snares, nets, etc). We present successful use of an endoscopic suturing device for retrieval of a large rectal foreign body not amenable to retrieval by traditional endoscopic extraction devices.
